description: Enhanced PDF Viewer for Power BI Embed, view, and annotate PDF documents directly in your Power BI reports. Features: - Page navigation with thumbnail previews - Zoom controls with fit-to-width option - Freehand drawing annotations in 6 colors - Automatic PDF and settings persistence - Fully customizable appearance Use Cases: - Financial reports and statements - Compliance documents - Project documentation - Sales materials - Training guides Customization Options: - Background and toolbar colors - Show/hide navigation and zoom controls - Show/hide file name and title - Adjustable toolbar and navigator dimensions Simply upload your PDF, navigate through pages, add annotations, and save your report. Everything persists automatically - your PDF, page position, zoom level, and all annotations. Works seamlessly in both Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service.
